outcome.description: The Superior Court granted the landlord summary judgment on liability and damages in the amount of $276,089.72, the full amount demanded, holding the force majeure clause allocated pandemic-closure risk to the tenant and two lease provisions relieved the landlord of any duty to relet. No attorney's fee award is stated. This is a trial-level decision; no appeal is reflected in the opinion.
outcome.appellateChange: n/a (trial-level decision; no appeal in opinion)

source.caseName: Dover Mall, LLC v. Sam Tang
source.court: Delaware Superior Court (Kent County), Resident Judge Jeffrey J Clark
source.excerptNote: Verbatim from the letter opinion's introduction (parties' positions), 'The Record and Procedural Background' section (including footnotes 16 and 17), and the fact-recitation portions of the Discussion (Tang's two affirmative defenses; his concession on the damages schedule). Removed: every sentence stating the court's rulings on liability, force majeure, mitigation, and the summary-judgment result; the long quoted remedy/reletting lease clauses; the case-law discussion; the Conclusion. The $276,089.72 figure that remains is Dover Mall's stated demand, not the result.
